decks.notes: The deck focuses on aggressively attacking the opponent with low-cost creatures and burn spells. It utilizes cards like Monastery Swiftspear, Light Up the Stage, and Soul-Scar Mage to deal quick damage to the opponent. The inclusion of burn spells like Skewer the Critics and Play with Fire helps finish off the opponent quickly. The deck's goal is to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of creatures and direct damage spells, utilizing its speed and efficiency to secure a victory.

This deck focuses on building up a strong board presence quickly by ramping up mana with cards like Elvish Mystic and Llanowar Elves, and then using that mana to play powerful green creatures like Cavalier of Thorns and Old-Growth Troll. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with a high devotion to green and aggressive play style, while also utilizing cards like Kiora, Behemoth Beckoner and Storm the Festival to generate additional value and card advantage. The deck aims to win the game through sheer force and efficiency.

This deck focuses on casting spells to fill the graveyard with Arclight Phoenix and then bringing them back from the graveyard to deal damage quickly. It relies on cheap spells and card draw to cycle through the deck efficiently, while also having counterspells and removal to control the board. The inclusion of Hall of Storm Giants and Treasure Cruise provides additional power and card advantage to outpace the opponent. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a relentless assault of creatures and burn spells while staying ahead on resources.

The main focus of this UW Control deck is to utilize a wide range of control spells and abilities to counter, remove, and disrupt your opponent's strategy. With a variety of counterspells, removal spells, card draw, and utility lands, this deck aims to control the game tempo, protect key threats, and generate value over time. The inclusion of Kaheera as a companion adds an additional threat and synergizes well with the rest of the deck. Overall, this deck is designed to outlast and outmaneuver opponents through careful planning and strategic decision-making.

The deck focuses on using cards like Indomitable Creativity and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker to create powerful combo plays. It utilizes a mix of spells, creatures, and enchantments to disrupt and outmaneuver opponents. The inclusion of Yorion, Sky Nomad as a companion adds an extra layer of versatility and creativity to the deck. Overall, the strategy revolves around generating value through creative card interactions and overwhelming the opponent with unexpected plays.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly ramp up mana with green devotion cards like Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx and Leyline of the Guildpact, then use that mana to play powerful green creatures like Old-Growth Troll and Cavalier of Thorns to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive plays. The deck also includes cards like Storm the Festival and Polukranos Reborn to further support the aggressive playstyle and maintain board presence. With a focus on green devotion and big creatures, this deck aims to quickly build a strong board presence and apply pressure to the opponent.

The deck focuses on controlling the game through a combination of removal spells, hand disruption, and graveyard interaction. It aims to outvalue the opponent by utilizing cards like Seasons Past and Virtue of Persistence to generate card advantage. The inclusion of powerful planeswalkers like Vraska, Golgari Queen and Liliana of the Veil provides additional control tools and threats. Additionally, the deck leverages the companion Kaheera, the Orphanguard for additional synergy and value. The mana base is focused on providing access to all necessary colors while also supporting the deck's strategy.

The deck focuses on quickly establishing a strong board presence and pressuring the opponent with aggressive creatures and efficient removal spells. It aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan with hand disruption like Thoughtseize and Duress, while also leveraging powerful planeswalkers like Sorin, Imperious Bloodlord to further enhance its threats. Utilizing a combination of evasive creatures like Vein Ripper and versatile removal like Fatal Push, the deck seeks to overwhelm the opponent and end the game swiftly. By combining aggressive creatures with disruptive elements, this Rakdos Aggro deck aims to dictate the pace of the game and secure a fast victory.

The deck focuses on using artifacts to quickly apply pressure on the opponent and control the board. By utilizing cards like Ensoul Artifact and Shrapnel Blast, the deck can deal damage efficiently and effectively. The inclusion of cards like Smuggler's Copter and Spyglass Siren allows for additional control and card advantage. With a strong mana base and a few key creatures, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a mix of aggro and artifact synergies. The companion, Jegantha, the Wellspring, provides additional value and flexibility to the deck.

The deck focuses on using the companion Keruga, the Macrosage to draw cards while playing a combination of creatures and spells that allow for explosive plays and powerful synergies. The deck includes a mix of lands, creatures like Greater Tanuki, Quintorius Kand, and Spinewoods Armadillo, as well as spells like Bedeck / Bedazzle and Leyline Binding. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of card advantage, versatile threats, and disruptive plays that can lead to a quick victory.

This control deck revolves around using Niv-Mizzet Reborn as the centerpiece of the deck, with a variety of multicolored spells to take advantage of his ability. The deck also includes a companion, Yorion, Sky Nomad, to provide additional value and flexibility. The deck features a mix of removal, ramp, and card draw spells, with a focus on utilizing the wide range of colors available in Pioneer to outvalue and outlast opposing decks. The inclusion of cards like Bring to Light and Fabled Passage allow for consistent color fixing and access to powerful spells in the deck.

This aggressive Red Deck Wins Pioneer deck focuses on quickly dealing damage to opponents through low-cost creatures and burn spells. Monastery Swiftspear and Soul-Scar Mage provide early damage, while Ramunap Ruins and Skewer the Critics offer additional burn. Ghitu Lavarunner and Wizard's Lightning provide consistent damage, while Slickshot Show-Off and Play with Fire can push through blockers. Kumano Faces Kakkazan and Monstrous Rage offer powerful late-game finishers, while Den of the Bugbear provides an extra threat. The deck aims to overwhelm opponents with fast, efficient creatures and burn spells to secure a quick victory.

This deck focuses on using spells to quickly power out Arclight Phoenix from the graveyard and generate card advantage through Treasure Cruise. It also utilizes disruptive spells like Lightning Axe and Spell Pierce to disrupt opponent's strategies. The inclusion of cards like Hall of Storm Giants and Picklock Prankster provide additional threats and ways to close out the game quickly. The goal is to apply pressure early and maintain a strong board presence to overwhelm opponents before they can stabilize.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize spells to quickly and efficiently fill the graveyard with Arclight Phoenixes, allowing them to be played for free and quickly attack the opponent. The deck focuses on drawing cards, discarding cards, and utilizing cheap spells to trigger the Phoenix's recursion ability. The inclusion of Opt, Ledger Shredder, and Treasure Cruise allows for quick card draw and graveyard filling, while cards like Lightning Axe and Fiery Impulse provide removal and protection. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a flurry of attacking Phoenixes and strong control elements.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly get Arclight Phoenix into the graveyard and bringing it back to the battlefield multiple times in a single turn. The deck includes ways to discard Phoenix, low-cost spells to trigger its return, and card draw to cycle through the deck quickly. The inclusion of Hall of Storm Giants allows for a potentially powerful finisher, while disruptive cards like Spell Pierce can help protect the game plan. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with fast, repetitive Phoenix attacks while maintaining card advantage and board control.

This deck focuses on using a wide variety of cards to control the game, utilizing Niv-Mizzet Reborn as its centerpiece. With a mix of removal spells, mana ramp, and powerful creatures, the deck aims to outvalue its opponent and stay ahead on board presence. The inclusion of Yorion, Sky Nomad as a companion allows for extra value and flexibility in the strategy. The deck also includes a variety of lands to ensure stable mana base and consistency in casting its powerful spells and creatures.
